english.meaning: n. 痕迹；v. 做标记；留意、注意
english.example: Mark my words, this trend will come back.（记住我的话）
english.quizQuestion: Mark my words 中的 mark 是什么意思？

english.content: if条件句：真实条件 vs 虚拟条件
english.meaning: 真实条件用主将从现；与现在相反用过去式，would+do。
english.example: If I were you, I would start earlier.
english.quizQuestion: If I ___ you, I would take the offer. 空格填什么？

english.meaning: n. 脸；表面；v. 面对；朝向
english.example: The building faces south. We need to face the problem.
english.quizQuestion: face 在 The building faces south 中是什么意思？

english.content: 每日一练：虚拟语气与过去事实相反
english.meaning: 表示与过去事实相反的假设，从句用had done，主句用would have done。
english.example: If he had studied harder, he would have passed.
english.quizQuestion: 与过去事实相反的if条件句，主句用什么结构？

english.content: 形容词与副词比较级、最高级
english.meaning: 两者比较用比较级，三者及以上用最高级，注意不规则变化。
english.example: This road is busier than that one. It's the busiest in the city.
english.quizQuestion: busy 的比较级和最高级怎么写？

english.meaning: ask询问；spend花费；talk交谈；ride骑乘；fly飞行
english.example: I asked him how he spent his weekend.
english.quizQuestion: spend 后面常接哪两类词？
english.quizAnswer: 时间/金钱 + on sth 或 (in) doing sth
